titre: Devoir de synthèse n°2 - Anglais (3ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Healthy eating has never been so important as it is today. In modern life, many people, especially young ones, prefer fast food such as burgers, chips and sugary drinks because it is cheap, quick and tasty. However, this kind of food is very dangerous for our health. Eating too much fast food can cause obesity, diabetes and heart disease. On the other hand, a balanced diet, rich in fruit, vegetables and natural products, keeps our body strong and our mind alert. Our grandparents, who ate simple and natural food, were often healthier than we are today. Therefore, we should return to good eating habits: cook at home, eat more fruit and vegetables, and avoid too much sugar and fat. As the saying goes, "We are what we eat."

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) Why do many young people prefer fast food?   (2 marks)
2) What diseases can too much fast food cause?   (2 marks)
3) What are the benefits of a balanced diet?   (2 marks)
4) What advice does the writer give at the end?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with "should": We ______ eat more fruit and vegetables.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with a relative pronoun (who / which): Our grandparents, ______ ate natural food, were healthier.   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a linker (however / because): Fast food is tasty; ______, it is dangerous.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "healthy" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"Why should we eat healthy food?" Write a composition (about 10-12 lines) explaining the importance of healthy eating and giving advice. Use "should" and linkers.
